cases.instruction: Write a short letter to the client's day activity centre asking them to arrange a later transport pickup.
cases.note: Client: Mdm Tan Siew Ling, 52. Diagnosed with schizophrenia in 2019, stable on medication, which makes her drowsy in the early morning. Uses a wheelchair since a stroke in 2024. Attends Bright Path DAC on weekdays. She has missed three DAC sessions this month because the transport provider moved the pickup to 7.15am and she cannot be ready that early; she needs about an hour of help to get ready. Plan: ask the DAC to arrange a pickup after 8.30am. She has consented to our sharing her transport needs with the DAC.
cases.draft:
Dear Bright Path DAC team,

Re: Mdm Tan Siew Ling

Mdm Tan has missed three sessions this month because the 7.15am transport pickup is too early for her to be ready. She uses a wheelchair and needs about an hour of help to get ready in the morning. Could you arrange a pickup after 8.30am from next week? Mdm Tan has agreed that we share her transport needs with you.

Thank you for your help.

cases.instruction: Write a short letter to the school counsellor asking for support with his attendance.
cases.note: Ravi Kumar, 14, Sec 2 at Sandpiper Secondary School. Youth Court: probation order for shoplifting, reporting to his probation officer every Tuesday afternoon. Attendance has dropped on Tuesdays. Parents consent to a letter to the school asking for support.
cases.draft:
Dear School Counsellor,

Re: Ravi Kumar (Sec 2)

Ravi is on a probation order from the Youth Court after a shoplifting charge and reports to his probation officer on Tuesday afternoons. His attendance has dropped on those days. We would be grateful for your support in helping him keep up with lessons he misses. His parents have consented to this letter.

Thank you.
